statement: Let K = F2, let k ≥ 2, and set q =  k − 1 3  , T = q + 2 2 ! . For pairwise distinct θ1, . . . , θk ∈ K, put D = diag(θ1, . . . , θk) and GD(X) = [sq tq ] perk(X + sI + tD), X ∈ Matk(K). Then dim{X ∈ Matk(K) : ∇GD(X) = 0} ≤ k2 + k − T. (6.1)
